queries.sql: SELECT relname, pg_get_userbyid(relowner), has_table_privilege(current_user,oid,'UPDATE'), has_table_privilege(current_user,oid,'DELETE'), has_table_privilege(current_user,oid,'TRUNCATE') FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND relname=ANY(%s)

SELECT c.relname,a.attname FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname=ANY(%s) AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND has_column_privilege(current_user,c.oid,a.attnum,'UPDATE')

SELECT p.proname,t.tgenabled,p.prosecdef,p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid WHERE t.tgrelid='public.safety_rightsaction'::regclass AND t.tgname='rights_evidence_action_scope'

SELECT c.relname,t.tgname,p.proname,t.tgenabled,p.prosecdef,p.pronamespace='public'::regnamespace FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid WHERE c.relnamespace='public'::regnamespace AND c.relname=ANY(%s) AND NOT t.tgisinternal

finding: Some catalogue result sets have no explicit row ordering although the seal digest records row order. Trust checks consume tables/triggers as sets or dictionaries; planner row-order drift could decline a valid seal and fall back to full validation.
status: Hypothesis only; no runtime mismatch attributed, no application correction applied. Await full-block diagnostic before targeted diagnosis.

primary_reference.verified_claim: Without explicit sorting, result ordering is unspecified and depends on scan/join plans and disk order.
primary_reference.limit: This supports the possible mechanism; it does not prove the cause of the recorded full-block failure.
